column1: # Pathogen and endosymbiont taxa of interest for the targeted follow-up analysis.
# `taxon` is matched against the genus column first, then family, then any rank
# in the lineage, so a family-level entry (e.g. Nairoviridae) captures every
#   both          genus contains both pathogenic and symbiotic lineages
# NOTE ON "both": Coxiella, Rickettsia and Francisella each contain obligate
# tick endosymbionts AND genuine pathogens that are near-identical over short
# contigs. A genus-level hit in these three does NOT establish pathogen
# presence -- that is exactly what the follow-up per-taxon phylogenetics is for.
# results/targets/target_contig_index.tsv gives the contigs to start from.
